title: Publishing details of deliberate defaulters reform
text: This measure changes the publishing details of deliberate defaulters legislation to allow HMRC to publish more information about deliberate non-compliance when publishing details of deliberate defaulters. It also allows HMRC to publish details of Personal Liability Notices.
changeNote: This measure has been updated as the publication threshold increase to £50,000 was made by Statutory Instrument laid on 11 September 2026 and came into force on 2 October 2026.
